description: This is a Gradle build script defining a synthetic test task 'syntheticPassingTest' that always succeeds, and configuring existing test tasks ('testDebugUnitTest' and 'testReleaseUnitTest') to depend on this synthetic task, ensuring they do not fail the CI pipeline due to missing tests.

methods.name: syntheticPassingTest
methods.description: Defines a synthetic Gradle Test task that always succeeds and points to an empty directory for test classes.

methods.name: whenReady
methods.description: Configures test tasks ('testDebugUnitTest' and 'testReleaseUnitTest') to depend on the synthetic test task and sets failure handling properties.
